definitions.explanation: A person or people with skills and abilities needed for a particular role. Also refers collectively to human resources within an organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な{人材|じんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: We are looking for talented people.

examples.japanese: {人材|じんざい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: We are putting effort into developing talent.

examples.japanese: IT⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人材|じんざい}{不足|ぶそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: In the IT field, a shortage of talent has become a serious problem.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人材|じんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to develop talent)
- {人材|じんざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to secure talent)
- {人材|じんざい}{不足|ぶそく} (talent shortage)
- {人材|じんざい}{派遣|はけん} (staffing, temporary staffing)
- {人材|じんざい}{紹介|しょうかい} (recruitment, headhunting)
- ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な{人材|じんざい} (excellent talent)

The variant {人財|じんざい} (using {財|ざい} meaning "treasure") is sometimes used by companies to emphasize that people are valuable assets.
